Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You have linked additional capacity to binding commitments; it sounds like planning certainty is what makes room for more volume. If you can secure our full requirement, we are ready to support that allocation with a firm long-term commitment. How can we make that commitment work for your capacity planning and dependable supply to Hollerau?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 24 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 24 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract, which facilitates our capacity allocation. In exchange for these extended terms and the 56-day lead time, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit. 

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please provide the underlying data for your should-cost estimate and demand forecast to substantiate your claims.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You explicitly link the longer commitment to capacity allocation and repeat the lead time; it sounds like planning certainty is central to making this work. We are ready to commit long-term in return for dependable coverage of our full requirement. What forecast detail would best help you plan and secure that capacity?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. To meet you, we now commit to the longer contract: 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.11 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We verified the labour cost index data you provided; it holds and has been factored into our calculation. We accept the 36-month contract term, as it supports our capacity planning. In exchange for this extended commitment, we propose a revised price of EUR 31.20 per unit. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is a price of €31.20 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Which volume can you commit to? Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
